/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/BlueSkyShip.name: Scimitar
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/BlueSkyShip.description: This blade-like landing craft is armed with Carpet Bomb air-support.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/BlueSkyShip.descriptionEn: This blade-like landing craft is armed with Carpet Bomb air-support.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/BlueSkyShip.descriptionZh: 这艘像刀刃一样的登陆艇装备了地毯式轰炸空中支援系统。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/DefaultShip.name: Liset
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/DefaultShip.description: The landing craft of choice utilised by the Tenno during their missions.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/DefaultShip.descriptionEn: The landing craft of choice utilised by the Tenno during their missions.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/DefaultShip.descriptionZh: Tenno 执行任务期间会选择使用这艘登陆艇。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/GrineerShip.name: SKAUT
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/GrineerShip.description:
A Grineer Bolkor remodeled for Tenno reinforcement. Skaut's alert signal calls Kahl and his Grineer brothers for backup. When backup is active, use the alert signal to replenish your squad's health. Each squad member can call one additional Grineer brother to join the fight.

Also available in the Market after completing the Veilbreaker quest.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/GrineerShip.descriptionEn:
A Grineer Bolkor remodeled for Tenno reinforcement. Skaut's alert signal calls Kahl and his Grineer brothers for backup. When backup is active, use the alert signal to replenish your squad's health. Each squad member can call one additional Grineer brother to join the fight.

Also available in the Market after completing the Veilbreaker quest.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/GrineerShip.descriptionZh:
一艘为了 Tenno 增援而重新改装的 Grineer 博寇。伺航的警报信号呼叫卡尔和他的 Grineer 兄弟们来支援。当支援起作用时，使用警报信号来补充你的小队生命值。每个小队成员可以额外呼叫一名 Grineer 兄弟加入战斗。

完成《破障者》系列任务后也可在商店内购得。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/GyroscopeShip.name: Xiphos
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/GyroscopeShip.description: Featuring Sentry Gun air-support, this stylish landing craft is an asset in any battle.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/GyroscopeShip.descriptionEn: Featuring Sentry Gun air-support, this stylish landing craft is an asset in any battle.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/GyroscopeShip.descriptionZh: 装备有自动炮台的空中支援系统，这艘时尚的登陆艇在任何战斗中都是实用的座驾。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/InsectShip.name: Mantis
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/InsectShip.description: This insect-like landing craft features Med-Tower air-support.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/InsectShip.descriptionEn: This insect-like landing craft features Med-Tower air-support.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/InsectShip.descriptionZh: 这架虫型的登陆艇装置了治愈塔，可支援空中作战。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/NoraShip.name: Nightwave
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/NoraShip.description: A landing craft model that pays homage to the forever-wandering home of pirate DJ Nora Night. Stay deadly, Dreamers. Nightwave's air support releases powerful sound waves, destroying weaker enemies while stunning more powerful ones.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/NoraShip.descriptionEn: A landing craft model that pays homage to the forever-wandering home of pirate DJ Nora Night. Stay deadly, Dreamers. Nightwave's air support releases powerful sound waves, destroying weaker enemies while stunning more powerful ones.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/NoraShip.descriptionZh: 一款向海盗 DJ 诺拉·夜 的永恒漫游之家致敬的登陆艇型号。时刻保持强大与敏锐吧，梦回者。午夜电波的空中支援系统能够释放强力声波，它能摧毁弱小的敌人，同时也能让强大的敌人陷入眩晕。

/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/ZarimanShip.name: Parallax
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/ZarimanShip.description: The Parallax was designed for Zariman interplanetary research. It can deploy the advanced Orokin Eye air support, which would have allowed colonizers to study areas rich in rare resources before landing.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/ZarimanShip.descriptionEn: The Parallax was designed for Zariman interplanetary research. It can deploy the advanced Orokin Eye air support, which would have allowed colonizers to study areas rich in rare resources before landing.
/Lotus/Types/Items/Ships/ZarimanShip.descriptionZh: （英文：PARALLAX）星察是为扎里曼的行星研究而设计的。它可部署先进的奥罗金之眼空中支援，可让殖民者在登陆前研究稀有资源丰富的地区。
